data.title: 诱宵美九 · 后台暗门后的绝对跨坐
data.description: 后台专属休息室反锁的门内，露肩针织衫半褪至腰间。美九双腿跨坐在达令的腿上，双臂环抱颈项，满面绯红主动将湿软唇瓣贴上，在深吻中发出甜腻的哭腔娇吟。
data.location: private locked VIP dressing suite with plush velvet couch
data.action: straddling partner on velvet couch, sweater slipping off shoulders, arms tight around neck, intense deep French kiss, breathless moans
data.lighting: dim romantic vanity lights creating sultry shadows on flushed skin
data.mood: overwhelming idol adoration, uninhibited passionate surrender, breathless longing
data.promptProse: Straddling partner lap on a backstage couch in dim lighting, Miku Izayoi kisses deeply with flushed cheeks, her sweater slipping off bare shoulders.
